title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 牧師分享了對神同在的體會，並穿插了幾個關於婚姻角色的幽默笑話。
lines: Every one of us have had the experience where we just randomly called a friend,
我們每個人都有過這樣的經歷，就是我們隨便打給一個朋友，
and come to find out it was the exact moment of crisis, and they needed help, and we didn't know.
結果發現那正是他們面臨危機的時刻，他們需要幫助，而我們並不知情。
那並不是某種雷鳴般的聲音；
it's the subtle leaning into a lifestyle of the presence of God, the Spirit of God,
而是微妙地投入一種有神同在、聖靈同在的生活方式，
where you think His thoughts, you declare His words.
在其中你思想祂的意念，宣告祂的話語。
It's not the strain and the effort of trying to hear from God.
這不是那種為了努力聽見神聲音而產生的緊繃和費力。
I don't hear well when I try.
當我刻意努力去聽時，反而聽不清楚。
Nice to see you. Good morning. Still morning.
很高興見到你們。早安，現在還是早上。
I have some very important things I'd love you to read.
我有一些非常重要的事情想讓你們讀一讀。
When everyone on Earth was dead and waiting to enter Heaven,
當地球上所有人都死了，並且在等待進入天堂時，
God appeared and said, "I want the men to make two lines."
神顯現並說：「我要男人們排成兩排。」
"One line for the men who were true heads of their household,"
「一排是真正作一家之主的男人，」
"and the other line for the men who were dominated by their women."
「另一排是那些被女人控制的男人。」
"I want all the women to report to St. Peter."
「我要所有的女人去向聖彼得報到。」
Soon the women were gone and there were two lines of men.
很快地，女人們都離開了，剩下了兩排男人。
The line of the men who were dominated by their wives was 100 miles long,
那些被妻子控制的男人，他們的隊伍有一百英里長，
and in the line of men who were truly heads of their household, there was only one man.
而在真正作一家之主的那排隊伍中，只有一個男人。
God said to the long line, "You men should be ashamed of yourselves!"
神對著那條長長的隊伍說：「你們這些男人應該感到羞愧！」
"I created you to be the head of your household."
「我創造你們是為了讓你們作一家之主。」
"You've been disobedient and have not fulfilled your purpose."
「你們一直不順服，也沒有完成你們的命定。」
"Of all of you, there's only one who obeyed; learn from him."
「你們所有人當中，只有一個人順服了；向他學習吧。」
God turned to the one man, "How did you manage to be the only one in this line?"
神轉向那唯一的男人：「你是怎麼做到成為這隊伍裡唯一的一個人的？」
The man replied, "My wife told me to stand here."
那男人回答：「我老婆叫我站在這裡。」
A boss was complaining in a staff meeting the other day; he wasn't getting any respect.
某天，一位老闆在員工會議上抱怨；他沒有得到任何尊重。
Later that morning, he went out and got a small sign that read, "I'm the boss."
那天早上晚些時候，他出去弄了一個小牌子，上面寫著：「我是老闆」。
He taped it to his office door.
他把牌子用膠帶貼在辦公室的門上。
Later that day, when he returned from lunch, he found that someone had taped a note to the sign that said, "Your wife called; she wants you to bring her sign back."
那天晚些時候，當他吃完午餐回來時，發現有人在牌子上貼了一張紙條，上面寫著：「你老婆打電話來；她要你把她的牌子帶回去。」
A man is talking to his wife.
一個男人正在跟他的妻子說話。
He says, "I'm the man of this house."
他說：「我是這個家的一家之主。」
"Starting tomorrow, I want you to have a hot, delicious meal ready for me the second I walk through the door."
「從明天開始，我要你在我進門的那一刻，就為我準備好一頓熱騰騰的美味佳餚。」
"Afterwards, while watching ESPN and relaxing in my chair, bring my slippers and then run my bath."
「之後，當我在看 ESPN 體育台、坐在椅子上放鬆時，把我的拖鞋拿來，然後去給我放洗澡水。」
She sat patiently listening, and he went on.
她耐心地坐著聽，然後他繼續說。
He says, "And when I'm done with my bath, guess who's going to dress me and comb my hair?"
他說：「等我洗完澡，猜猜誰要來給我穿衣服和梳頭髮？」
她回答：「殯儀館的禮儀師。」
